newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo tea prices rise as quality seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Colombo tea prices rise as quality seen falling.

text.p: Tea prices rose at the Colombo auction on good demand mainly from Russia and the Middle East ahead of holidays coupled with anticipation of lower quality next week, brokers said on Wednesday.

"Prices were firm to dearer," said a broker at Eastern Brokers. "Next week's sale is much larger but quality is not interesting. People bought a little more this week as buying next week leaves no time for processing due to holidays."
The anticipated gross sale average for the 4.9 million kg on offer rose to 104.50 rupees ($1.85) per kg from 102.22 rupees last week, brokers Forbes & Walker said.
The next auction is on December 17-18 where 5.9 million kg will be on offer. ($=56.46 rupees).
